observations: Photo shows a front-load LG washing machine with a round door and control panel.
On the front panel it reads “DirectDrive 7kg” (visible on photo 0).
There is visible rust/staining around the lower front edge/trim area (photo 0).
No model number/serial plate is visible in the photo (photo 0).
Seller text claims it is the 8kg one, but the photo text shows 7kg (photo 0).

claims.claim: LG DirectDrive 7kg washing machine for sale.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows “LG” logo and “DirectDrive 7kg” text on the machine front.
Photo 0 clearly shows “DirectDrive 7kg” on the front panel.
No location details are shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Capacity mismatch (seller says 8kg but photo shows 7kg), which affects pricing and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the rating/serial plate (usually inside the door frame or at the back) showing the exact capacity (kg) and model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as the worst-case shown: 7kg DirectDrive (and treat seller’s 8kg claim as false until proven).

risks.risk: Possible rust/corrosion at the lower front area could indicate water ingress, poor drainage, or long-term exposure—may lead to leaks or structural issues.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the bottom rim/door seal area and the underside/back for any water stains; also request a short video of a full wash cycle with no leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a unit that may need service (treat as not guaranteed leak-free).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (no power-on, no cycle test shown).
risks.proof: Request a video: power on + selecting a program + starting a wash + showing water filling and drum movement/spin.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or untested until a cycle test is shown.

risks.risk: Model number and exact variant are not readable, which affects spare parts availability and comparable pricing.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the model/serial label (rating plate) and the back panel label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price using the visible worst-case identity only (LG DirectDrive 7kg) without assuming a specific variant.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating/serial plate showing exact capacity (kg) and model number.
Short video of a full wash cycle (start to spin) showing no leaks and normal operation.
Close-up photos of the door seal and the lower front/rust area, plus underside/back for water staining.
response.reason: The photo confirms an LG DirectDrive 7kg, contradicting the seller’s 8kg claim, and the photos don’t show working condition or the model/serial plate. Without a cycle test and the rating plate, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
